findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion list is litellm plus the fourteen command modules only, so nothing fails when the schema runtime is imported on the initialize path, and a fresh-interpreter probe of that exact path shows linkml_runtime and imas_codex.graph.schema in sys.modules because imas_codex/llm/server.py imports imas_codex.graph.query_builder at module level — the done_when clause naming the schema runtime therefore has no guard and the condition it forbids is present in the landed code; the repair is to defer the server's own imports, which the manifest already records under outside_scope.

non-blocking: the docstring asserts the verdict holds whether or not the deferred warm-up has started, but neither the test nor the record starts the warm-up, and the done_when's ten-consecutive-run clause has no result in the fragment or the manifest, so a claim of stability across warm-up states is made without the measurement that would show it.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 8365c9c9e7f2 against base 980fa78b5d18 commit by commit; it is 1217 insertions over six files — the deferred command table and group replacing register_commands, two import-boundary tests, a hardcoded per-mode tool-name set, and the timing script, JSON record and fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names eight clauses; the record answers the five-cold-start medians and their loads in startup-timings.json, serve --help at 0.17 s, the three serve modes' tool lists, and the fifteen-command listing, but the clause requiring a test to fail when the schema runtime is imported on the path that answers initialize is unasserted at tests/discovery/test_engine_import_order.py:105, which stops at litellm and the fourteen command modules while linkml_runtime is in sys.modules on that same path, and the ten-consecutive-run warm-up stability clause has no record in the fragment or the manifest.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that imas-codex serve answers initialize in under ten seconds by resolving command modules only when invoked; imas_codex/cli/__init__.py:35 replaces register_commands with the _COMMANDS table and imas_codex/cli/__init__.py:117 adds DeferredCommandGroup.get_command importing a module on first use, measured at 3.80 s median on the debug node and 11.98 s on the fleet node, so the goal holds on the debug node and on the done_when's own 15 s fleet threshold while the fleet node where sessions run still answers above ten seconds.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete, 21 passed on the head gate and 64 passed on the command-line tests, names the negative-control log, and states the debug-node median 3.80 s (base 8.32 s) and fleet median 11.98 s (base 23.95 s); all four named logs exist on disk and read as stated.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares six paths and git show --stat 8365c9c9 over its single commit touches exactly those six — imas_codex/cli/__init__.py, tests/discovery/test_engine_import_order.py, tests/llm/test_tool_schemas.py and the three files under docs/evidence/fragments/serve-answers-inside-the-connect-limit/ — and no seventh path.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_engine_import_order.py:72 and :87 redden at the base revision, which negative-control.log shows quoting the fourteen module names and 'litellm imported', but no assertion covers the schema runtime even though imas_codex/llm/server.py puts linkml_runtime on that very path, so the boundary guard is narrower than the done_when states.
justifications.evidence: startup-timings.json records five runs per arm with their load averages and head-gate-final.log records 21 passed EXIT=0, but the 94.5 % attribution at docs/evidence/fragments/serve-answers-inside-the-connect-limit/saicl-lazy-command-group.html:20 rests on an importtime profile that is on no log, the schema-runtime clause has no assertion, and the ten-run stability clause is unrecorded.
justifications.fit: DeferredCommandGroup at imas_codex/cli/__init__.py:92 extends click.Group and follows the module's docstring-and-type-hint idiom, but the help text now has two homes — the table at imas_codex/cli/__init__.py:37 and each command's own docstring — which will drift.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/cli/__init__.py:117 resolves each command module in get_command instead of at import, and the measured median is 3.80 s on the debug node and 11.98 s on the fleet node, so the lazy resolution is delivered while the fleet node stays above the goal's headline ten seconds.
justifications.reuse: a search of imas_codex/cli for a click.Group subclass, a get_command override or a LazyGroup found none and click itself ships none, so the new class fills an unowned gap by extending the click.Group contract rather than duplicating a repository mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in commit 8365c9c9 is one of the six declared write paths, and the only behaviour beyond the goal it carries is that list_commands now sorts alphabetically at imas_codex/cli/__init__.py:99.
